verses.text: A Psalm of Asaph. God takes His stand in His own congregation; He judges in the midst of the rulers.
verses.textZh: （亞薩的詩。）神站在有權力者的會中，在諸　神中行審判，

verses.text: How long will you judge unjustly And show partiality to the wicked? Selah.
verses.textZh: 說：你們審判不秉公義，徇惡人的情面，要到幾時呢？（細拉）

verses.text: Vindicate the weak and fatherless; Do justice to the afflicted and destitute.
verses.textZh: 你們當為貧寒的人和孤兒伸冤；當為困苦和窮乏的人施行公義。

verses.text: Rescue the weak and needy; Deliver [them] out of the hand of the wicked.
verses.textZh: 當保護貧寒和窮乏的人，救他們脫離惡人的手。

verses.text: They do not know nor do they understand; They walk about in darkness; All the foundations of the earth are shaken.
verses.textZh: 你們仍不知道，也不明白，在黑暗中走來走去；地的根基都搖動了。

verses.text: I said, 'You are gods, And all of you are sons of the Most High.
verses.textZh: 我曾說：你們是神，都是至高者的兒子。

verses.text: 'Nevertheless you will die like men And fall like [any] one of the princes.'
verses.textZh: 然而，你們要死，與世人一樣，要仆倒，像王子中的一位。

verses.text: Arise, O God, judge the earth! For it is You who possesses all the nations.
verses.textZh: 神啊，求你起來審判世界，因為你要得萬邦為業。
